environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Flask app runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers. API keys are distributed to 12 internal developers for testing.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP passthrough on port 8080
